description: Driver 1 must rest if Driver 2 is assigned, or Vehicle 101 must take relief driver: (D1_REST v ~D2_ASSIGNED v V101_RELIEF)
Flammable cargo cannot be packed with standard cargo unless certified container is active: (~HAZMAT v CERT_CONTAINER v ~STD_CARGO)
Urgent package PKG-7002 must take route Lane A or Lane B before 10 AM: (LANE_A v LANE_B v RESCHEDULE)
Electric van VEH-102 or VEH-111 must cover Manhattan zone, not Heavy Truck: (V102_ZONE v V111_ZONE v ~V101_ZONE)
Morning Dallas freight crossdock requires Gate 1 or Gate 2 open with Inspector on site: (GATE_1 v GATE_2 v INSP_ON_SITE)
Route Corridor Chicago-Detroit and Corridor Chicago-Pittsburgh cannot both exceed peak volume without relief depot: (~CH_DET_PEAK v ~CH_PIT_PEAK v RELIEF_DEPOT)
